The NYC Hit List

Francie

Williamsburg

A candlelit Williamsburg dining room serving New American food with serious ambition. The duck and the ricotta gnocchi are not to be missed.

Tatiana

Lincoln Center

Chef Kwame Onwuachi's love letter to the African diaspora, set inside Lincoln Center. Bold flavors and an electric atmosphere make this one of the most exciting restaurants in the city.

Don Angie

West Village

This West Village Italian-American spot from Scott Tacinelli and Angie Rito is perpetually packed for good reason. The pinwheel lasagna is legendary.
